summary: Strict end-to-end verification of the v142 deep-hierarchy fix at BOTH the data layer (IndexedDB IronRabbit/notes) and the render layer (Home List View recursive tree). Created notes via the real Note Editor (FAB → title → Category path accordion → Add sub-level × N → Create) at 4 levels and 5 levels, dumped the persisted records straight out of IndexedDB, and drove the recursive expansion of CategoryGroup → NestedSubGroup on Home. All four required proofs PASS.

issues: Persistent React hydration console error: <button data-testid='category-hierarchy-*'> (HierarchyPathButton) is rendered as a descendant of <button data-testid='category-toggle-*'>. Non-blocking but pollutes console on every render — same issue flagged in iteration_63.

action_items: No functional action required for the deep-hierarchy fix — verified at data AND render layer for 4 and 5 levels, plus edit-preservation round-trip.

(Optional/minor, unchanged from iter_63) Fix nested-button hydration warning in CategoryGroup.jsx: move HierarchyPathButton out of the outer <button data-testid='category-toggle-*'> so they are siblings.
critical_code_review_comments: NoteModal.jsx handleSave (L323-387) cleanPath is authoritative and produces the correct legacy pair (category=cleanPath[0], subcategory=cleanPath[1]) alongside the full category_path — verified for both 4-level and 5-level saves.

NotesApp.jsx handleSaveNote/grouped useMemo (L1729-1794) correctly groups by legacyCat || category_path[0], so the note surfaces only under the true TOP-LEVEL (MainHierarchy4 / MainHierarchy5) and never leaks deeper segments as top-level buckets.

CategoryGroup + NestedSubGroup recursion correctly renders arbitrary depth (verified at N=4 and N=5): note tile appears exclusively at the leaf (SubGamma / LevelFive) and is absent at every intermediate depth.
Edit-and-resave preserves category_path exactly (round-trip): the 'stale state overwrite' bug that motivated the v142 fix does NOT reproduce.

CategoryPathAccordion (L29) defaults `open=true` — clicking category-path-toggle in an already-open accordion COLLAPSES it (a subtle test-authoring pitfall, not a product bug; the initial state is already open when the modal mounts).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 assertions: T1_data, T1_list, T2_data, T2_list, T3_edit)

seed_data_creation: Temporarily created 2 notes via UI (HierarchyTest-4L, HierarchyTest-5L) + edited copy (HierarchyTest-4L-edited). All deleted from IndexedDB at end of run. No preexisting user data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deep-hierarchy fix (v142) is confirmed at data + render layer for 4L and 5L, and survives edit round-trip. Evidence dumped: T1 rec = {title:'HierarchyTest-4L', category:'MainHierarchy4', subcategory:'SubAlpha', category_path:['MainHierarchy4','SubAlpha','SubBeta','SubGamma']}. T2 rec = {title:'HierarchyTest-5L', category:'MainHierarchy5', subcategory:'LevelTwo', category_path:['MainHierarchy5','LevelTwo','LevelThree','LevelFour','LevelFive']}. T3 rec (after title edit only) = {title:'HierarchyTest-4L-edited', category:'MainHierarchy4', subcategory:'SubAlpha', category_path:['MainHierarchy4','SubAlpha','SubBeta','SubGamma']}. Home top-level category-group testids after T2 = ['category-group-MainHierarchy4','category-group-MainHierarchy5','category-group-Test','category-group-Test notes','category-group-X'] — no LevelTwo/Three/Four/Five/SubAlpha/SubBeta/SubGamma leak as top-level. Nested-subgroup toggles chain correctly SubAlpha→SubBeta→SubGamma and LevelTwo→LevelThree→LevelFour→LevelFive. Note tile appears exactly once at the deepest leaf. NOTE: category-path accordion in NoteModal defaults to OPEN — do not click category-path-toggle first or you will collapse it. To open the editor for an existing note, click accordion-note-title-{id} to expand the accordion, then click accordion-edit-{id} — clicking a category-group-XXX area does not open the editor. FAB (fab-add-note) can be flaky under Playwright's default click when a featured-tip banner is present; JS click (element.click()) works reliably. IndexedDB is name='IronRabbit', storeName='notes' (not 'iron_rabbit_notes' as originally referenced in the request). Pre-existing hydration console errors from nested <button> (HierarchyPathButton inside category-toggle) still present, unchanged from iter_63.
rca of the issue: No issue to RCA — the reported bug does NOT reproduce on v142. Fix chain confirmed: (a) CategoryPathAccordion emits the full array via onChange; (b) NoteModal.handleSave derives cleanPath = trimmed(categoryPath) and persists {category: cleanPath[0], subcategory: cleanPath[1], category_path: cleanPath} atomically — no stale state overwrite from legacy single-category state; (c) NotesApp.grouped useMemo groups by (legacy category || category_path[0]) so the top-level bucket is always the true root; (d) CategoryGroup + NestedSubGroup render arbitrary-depth children recursively so the note tile lands only at the leaf. Verified at both 4L and 5L depths, plus a title-only edit which preserves category_path exactly.
